scope: Journal-facing philosophical revision only; no scientific result, source adjudication, validation score, or structural-analysis artifact is changed.

philosophical_revision.central_shift: Reconstruction or explanatory success is treated as genuine abductive evidence whose evidential reach is nevertheless underdetermining with respect to the source of recovered invariance.
philosophical_revision.beni_relation: Beni is treated as a positive interlocutor. PP-FEP explanatory/unificatory success supports PP-FEP as a candidate framework; it does not by itself distinguish source-side invariance from framework-enabled accommodation or a mixture of both.
philosophical_revision.source_first_relation: The Paper 2 reconstruction is described as source-first only in a limited sense: source-local commitments are reconstructed before comparison with PP-FEP and not by first translating every source into PP-FEP vocabulary. No framework-free or representation-neutral status is claimed.
philosophical_revision.positive_contribution: Framework-guided and source-first routes are treated as epistemically complementary. Convergence strengthens robustness; divergence localizes framework contribution.
philosophical_revision.explanatory_success_boundary: Reconstruction success may be one premise in the warrant. What is excluded is using that same success as the sole discriminator of identity-bearing invariance.
candidate_additional_warrant: novel prediction tied to the proposed invariant
contrastive superiority over plausible rival representations
convergence with a differently constructed reconstruction route

scientific_authority_unchanged.prospective_MAIN40: 40/40 source-sufficient under the original reconstruction criterion
